title.id: Ki Hajar Dewantara dan sekolah untuk semua
title.en: Ki Hajar Dewantara and a school for everyone

ST-KI-HAJAR.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Ki Hadjar Dewantara" (born 2 May 1889, Yogyakarta; Taman Siswa schools from July 1922); RRI, "The Life Journey of the 'Father of Education' Ki Hajar Dewantara" (birth name Soewardi Soerjaningrat; Taman Siswa 3 July 1922; Hari Pendidikan Nasional 2 May); detik.com, "Logo Tut Wuri Handayani: makna, arti, dan sejarahnya" (motto, 'di belakang memberi dorongan', ministry logo).

caption.id: Ki Hajar Dewantara lahir di Yogyakarta tahun 1889. Nama kecilnya Soewardi.
caption.en: Ki Hajar Dewantara was born in Yogyakarta in 1889. His childhood name was Soewardi.

caption.id: Waktu itu, Indonesia dijajah Belanda. Hanya sedikit anak Indonesia yang bisa bersekolah.
caption.en: Back then, Indonesia was ruled by the Dutch. Only a few Indonesian children could go to school.

caption.id: Tahun 1922, ia mendirikan sekolah Taman Siswa di Yogyakarta. Di sana, anak-anak Indonesia bisa belajar.
caption.en: In 1922 he founded the Taman Siswa school in Yogyakarta. There, Indonesian children could learn.

caption.id: Semboyannya, "Tut Wuri Handayani", artinya guru memberi semangat dari belakang. Semboyan itu ada di logo pendidikan Indonesia.
caption.en: His motto, "Tut Wuri Handayani", means a teacher encourages from behind. It is on the logo of Indonesian education.

caption.id: Kini, hari lahirnya, 2 Mei, menjadi Hari Pendidikan Nasional. Semua anak berhak belajar!
caption.en: Today his birthday, 2 May, is National Education Day. Every child has the right to learn!

ST-KARTINI.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Kartini" (born 21 April 1879, Mayong, Java; letters to Dutch friends; Door Duisternis tot Licht, 1911); ANTARA, "Kartini" (secluded from age 12; small school at her home, letter of 4 July 1903; Habis Gelap Terbitlah Terang; Hari Kartini 21 April; National Hero 1964); Kartini, Habis Gelap Terbitlah Terang (Balai Pustaka).

caption.id: Kartini lahir di Jepara, Jawa Tengah, tahun 1879. Ia senang sekali belajar.
caption.en: Kartini was born in Jepara, Central Java, in 1879. She loved to learn.

caption.id: Saat berumur 12 tahun, Kartini harus berhenti sekolah dan tinggal di rumah. Begitulah adat bagi anak perempuan bangsawan saat itu.
caption.en: When she was 12, Kartini had to leave school and stay at home. That was the custom for noble girls at the time.

caption.id: Kartini terus membaca dan menulis surat kepada sahabatnya di Belanda. Ia ingin anak perempuan juga bisa bersekolah.
caption.en: Kartini kept reading and wrote letters to her friends in the Netherlands. She wanted girls to go to school too.

caption.id: Tahun 1903, Kartini membuka sekolah kecil untuk anak perempuan. Ia sendiri yang mengajar.
caption.en: In 1903 Kartini opened a small school for girls. She taught there herself.

caption.id: Setelah Kartini wafat, surat-suratnya dijadikan buku, Habis Gelap Terbitlah Terang. Kini setiap 21 April kita merayakan Hari Kartini.
caption.en: After Kartini died, her letters became a book, Habis Gelap Terbitlah Terang (After Darkness Comes Light). Every 21 April we celebrate Kartini Day.

title.en: Florence Nightingale, the lady with the lamp

ST-NIGHTINGALE.source: Science Museum Group Collection, "Florence Nightingale 1820-1910" (born 12 May 1820, Florence; Scutari, November 1854, with 38 nurses; food, blankets, cleanliness; 'Lady of the Lamp'; Nightingale Training School, St Thomas' Hospital, 1860); Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Florence Nightingale"; International Council of Nurses: International Nurses Day, 12 May.

caption.id: Florence Nightingale lahir di Italia tahun 1820 dan besar di Inggris. Ia ingin merawat orang sakit.
caption.en: Florence Nightingale was born in Italy in 1820 and grew up in England. She wanted to care for sick people.

caption.id: Tahun 1854, ia dan 38 perawat pergi ke sebuah rumah sakit tentara di Turki. Rumah sakit itu kotor, dan banyak pasien sakit parah.
caption.en: In 1854 she and 38 nurses went to an army hospital in Turkey. The hospital was dirty, and many patients were very ill.

caption.id: Florence dan para perawat membersihkan rumah sakit dan menyiapkan makanan. Pasien pun dirawat dengan lebih baik.
caption.en: Florence and the nurses cleaned the hospital and prepared food. The patients were cared for much better.

caption.id: Malam hari, ia berkeliling membawa lampu untuk menengok pasien. Orang menyebutnya "Perempuan Berlampu".
caption.en: At night she walked around with a lamp to check on the patients. People called her "the Lady with the Lamp".

caption.id: Tahun 1860, ia membuka sekolah perawat di London. Kini hari lahirnya, 12 Mei, menjadi Hari Perawat Internasional.
caption.en: In 1860 she opened a school for nurses in London. Now her birthday, 12 May, is International Nurses Day.

caption.id: Dari Florence, kita belajar peduli kepada orang sakit dan menjaga kebersihan.
caption.en: From Florence we learn to care for sick people and to keep things clean.

title.en: Dewi Sartika and the girls' school

ST-DEWI-SARTIKA.source: detik.com, "Sekolah Perempuan Pertama Indonesia Ada di Bandung, Siapa Pendirinya?" (born 4 December 1884; taught servants' children with boards and charcoal as a child; Sakola Istri opened 16 January 1904 at the Bandung regency pendopo; reading, sewing, cooking and more; National Hero 1966); Wikipedia, "Dewi Sartika" (renamed Sakola Kaoetamaan Isteri 1910; nine schools in West Java by 1912).

caption.id: Dewi Sartika lahir di Jawa Barat tahun 1884. Waktu kecil, ia suka bermain sekolah-sekolahan.
caption.en: Dewi Sartika was born in West Java in 1884. As a child, she loved playing school.

caption.id: Ia mengajari anak-anak di sekitarnya membaca dan menulis. Papan tulisnya dari kayu, kapurnya dari arang!
caption.en: She taught the children around her to read and write. Her board was made of wood, and her chalk was charcoal!

caption.id: Waktu itu, banyak anak perempuan tidak bisa bersekolah. Dewi Sartika ingin mereka pandai dan mandiri.
caption.en: In those days, many girls could not go to school. Dewi Sartika wanted them to learn and to stand on their own feet.

caption.id: Tanggal 16 Januari 1904, ia membuka Sakola Istri di Bandung, sekolah untuk anak perempuan. Muridnya belajar membaca, berhitung, dan menjahit.
caption.en: On 16 January 1904 she opened Sakola Istri in Bandung, a school for girls. The pupils learned reading, arithmetic and sewing.

caption.id: Sekolahnya bertambah di banyak kota di Jawa Barat. Kini Dewi Sartika menjadi Pahlawan Nasional.
caption.en: Her schools spread to many towns in West Java. Today Dewi Sartika is a National Hero of Indonesia.

caption.id: Dari Dewi Sartika, kita belajar berbagi ilmu dengan teman.
caption.en: From Dewi Sartika we learn to share what we know with others.

ST-ZHENG-HE.source: Britannica Kids, "Zheng He" (born about 1371, Yunnan, Hui family; seven expeditions from 1405; first fleet 62 treasure ships and more than 200 smaller vessels; Southeast Asia including Java, India, Arabia, East Africa); Katadata, "Jejak Perjalanan Cheng Ho di Indonesia" (Java, Sumatra, Sam Poo Kong in Semarang); Macao Cultural Institute, Review of Culture (compass and star board on Zheng He's fleet).

caption.id: Zheng He, atau Cheng Ho, lahir di Tiongkok sekitar tahun 1371. Ia menjadi laksamana, pemimpin para pelaut.
caption.en: Zheng He, also called Cheng Ho, was born in China around 1371. He became an admiral, a leader of sailors.

caption.id: Mulai tahun 1405, ia memimpin tujuh pelayaran besar. Pada pelayaran pertama, ada lebih dari 200 kapal!
caption.en: From 1405 he led seven great voyages. On the first voyage there were more than 200 ships!

caption.id: Kapal-kapalnya berlayar ke Asia Tenggara, India, Arab, dan Afrika. Mereka mencari arah dengan kompas dan bintang.
caption.en: His ships sailed to Southeast Asia, India, Arabia and Africa. They found their way with a compass and the stars.

caption.id: Ia juga singgah di Jawa dan Sumatra untuk berdagang dan bersahabat. Di Semarang, Klenteng Sam Poo Kong mengenang kedatangannya.
caption.en: He also stopped in Java and Sumatra to trade and make friends. In Semarang, the Sam Poo Kong temple remembers his visit.

caption.id: Pelayaran Zheng He menghubungkan banyak bangsa. Kita belajar berani menjelajah dan bersahabat dengan semua orang.
caption.en: Zheng He's voyages linked many peoples. We learn to be brave explorers and friends to everyone.

title.en: Ibn Battuta, the traveller from Morocco

ST-IBN-BATTUTA.source: World History Encyclopedia, "Ibn Battuta" (born 25 February 1304, Tangier; left June 1325 aged 21 for the hajj; about 1325-1352; 75,000 miles / 120,000 km; caravans; Rihla written down by Ibn Juzayy c. 1352-1355; died 1368 or 1369); Wikipedia, "Samudera Pasai Sultanate" (visit in 1345, about two weeks as the sultan's guest).

caption.id: Ibn Battuta lahir di kota Tangier, Maroko, tahun 1304. Ia senang belajar dan ingin melihat dunia.
caption.en: Ibn Battuta was born in Tangier, Morocco, in 1304. He loved learning and wanted to see the world.

caption.id: Tahun 1325, saat berumur 21 tahun, ia berangkat naik haji ke Mekah. Ia berjalan bersama kafilah unta.
caption.en: In 1325, at the age of 21, he set off on the pilgrimage to Mecca. He travelled with a camel caravan.

caption.id: Ia terus berkelana hampir 30 tahun, ke Afrika, India, Tiongkok, dan Sumatra. Jauhnya sekitar 120.000 kilometer!
caption.en: He kept travelling for almost 30 years, to Africa, India, China and Sumatra. That's about 120,000 kilometres!

caption.id: Di Sumatra, ia singgah di Kerajaan Samudera Pasai sekitar tahun 1345. Ia disambut sebagai tamu sultan.
caption.en: In Sumatra he stopped at the kingdom of Samudera Pasai around 1345. He was welcomed as the sultan's guest.

caption.id: Setelah pulang, ia menceritakan perjalanannya, dan seorang penulis mencatatnya. Buku itu bernama Rihlah, artinya "perjalanan".
caption.en: Back home, he told the story of his travels, and a writer wrote it down. The book is called the Rihla, which means "journey".

caption.id: Berkat bukunya, kita tahu seperti apa dunia hampir 700 tahun lalu. Kita belajar ingin tahu dan mencatat apa yang kita lihat.
caption.en: Thanks to his book, we know what the world was like almost 700 years ago. We learn to be curious and to write down what we see.

items.source: Smithsonian Magazine, "The Peculiar Story of the Giraffes of Medieval China" (2017): envoys from Malindi (Kenya) gave a giraffe that reached China with Zheng He's fourth voyage and was presented as a qilin.

model_answer.id: Armada Zheng He pernah membawa seekor jerapah dari Afrika ke Tiongkok! Ada yang menyamakannya dengan qilin, hewan dalam dongeng Tiongkok.
model_answer.en: Zheng He's fleet once carried a giraffe from Africa to China! Some people compared it to the qilin, a creature from Chinese legends.

meaning.id: Jarumku selalu menunjuk ke utara. Pelaut memakaiku untuk mencari arah. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: My needle always points north. Sailors use me to find their way. What am I?

model_answer.id: Kompas! Jarumnya menunjuk ke utara, jadi pelaut seperti Zheng He tahu arah.
model_answer.en: A compass! Its needle points north, so sailors like Zheng He knew which way to go.
